training.module.name: Training
training.module.description: Courses and the sign-offs that complete them, the training records people hold and when they lapse, and the competencies other modules can require, such as Duty manager or Till operator.
training.settings.records.default-valid-: How long a new course stays valid
Offered when a course is created. Each course's own validity is what counts, and can be changed on the course.
training.settings.records.warn-before.la: Warn people before their training lapses
training.settings.records.warn-before.he: How long before the expiry a person is told and their training shows as expiring soon.
training.settings.records.renew-window.l: Renewing early keeps the old expiry when done within
training.settings.records.renew-window.h: Renewing this close to the expiry runs the new validity from the old expiry, so nobody loses time by renewing early.
training.settings.records.renew-grace.la: After lapsing, renewal is still enough for
training.settings.records.renew-grace.he: Within this time after a lapse the shorter renewal steps are enough. After it the whole course is needed.
training.settings.records.digest.label: Send a weekly summary to training managers
training.settings.records.digest.help: Lists training that is lapsing and sessions still to be marked.
training.settings.versions.retrain-grace: When a new version needs retraining, people keep their training for
Then training from the older version ends. Lengthening this keeps people counted as trained on material the new version has replaced.
training.settings.progress.complete-with: A sign-off counts towards finishing a course for
Sign-offs older than this no longer count towards a course not yet finished.
training.settings.sessions.default-capac: Places offered for a new session
Each session's own capacity is what counts.
training.settings.sessions.sign-up-close: People can sign themselves up until this long before a session
Staff can still add people after that.
People can cancel their own place until this long before a session
After that they are told to contact a trainer.
training.settings.sessions.reminder-befo: Remind people this long before a session
People can switch the reminder off.
A full session takes a waiting list
When a place is freed, the first person waiting gets it and is told.
training.settings.sessions.mark-within.l: Attendance can be marked or corrected until this long after a session
training.settings.sessions.mark-within.h: A session still unmarked by then is shown to its trainers until they finish it.
training.settings.evidence.self-submit.l: People can send in their own certificates
training.settings.evidence.self-submit.h: Every certificate is still checked by someone before it counts.
training.settings.evidence.chase-after.l: Show certificates and declarations still waiting after
training.settings.evidence.chase-after.h: They are shown on the console home of the people who check them and in the weekly summary.
training.settings.quizzes.default-max-at: Tries offered for a new quiz
Each quiz's own limit is what counts. A person who uses them all waits before trying again.
training.settings.quizzes.retry-after.la: After using every try, a person can try a quiz again after
training.settings.quizzes.retry-after.he: Offered for a new quiz. A trainer can let someone try again sooner.
training.settings.retention.records.labe: Keep ended or lapsed training records for
training.settings.retention.records.help: Then they are anonymised. Shortening this lets the next clear-out anonymise records that cannot be brought back.
training.settings.retention.evidence.lab: Keep certificates and their files after the training they earned ends for
training.settings.retention.evidence.hel: Then they are deleted. Shortening this lets the next clear-out delete files that cannot be brought back.
training.settings.retention.attendance.l: Keep places on sessions and quiz attempts for
training.settings.retention.attendance.h: Then they are removed. Shortening this lets the next clear-out remove rows that cannot be brought back.
training.settings.rules.warn-inside-vali: The warning before training lapses must be shorter than how long a new course stays valid.
training.settings.rules.renew-inside-val: The early renewal window cannot be longer than how long a new course stays valid.
training.settings.rules.evidence-not-out: Certificates cannot be kept for longer than the training records they earned.
training.settings.rules.reminder-before-: The session reminder must arrive while people can still cancel their own place.
training.settings.rules.retry-inside-pro: The wait before trying a quiz again must be shorter than how long a sign-off counts towards finishing a course.
